fact: On 11 February 2026 a World Bank delegation visiting with the health minister found the eGabon health information system working in the 13 pilot hospitals of Grand Libreville; the director of the Egypto-Gabonese cooperation hospital said that in a year it had made the patient record available, and the ministry asked for extension to the Centre hospitalier universitaire de Libreville and to every regional hospital, which are not yet covered.
title: Projet eGabon-SIS : la Banque Mondiale satisfaite du bon fonctionnement du système dans les hôpitaux pilotes
